description: This file defines an internal class 'NoOpCommandInterceptor' implementing the 'ICommandInterceptor' interface, used as a no-operation placeholder for command interception within different Orleans AdoNet storage namespaces. It provides a singleton instance and an empty 'Intercept' method.

classes.name: NoOpCommandInterceptor
classes.description: An internal class implementing ICommandInterceptor with a singleton instance that performs no operation in its 'Intercept' method.

methods.name: Intercept
methods.description: Method intended to intercept a database command; currently a no-operation placeholder.
